_comment: Circulatory Flow map balance. The run is a seeded branching tree of blood vessels: depth = layers of chambers, routes = the vessel TYPES connecting them. Blood pressure is the risk dial — arteries raise it for loot, bypasses lower it to recover. Every number is a balance knob; tests/vesselmap.test.js re-verifies structure and bounds after any wiggle.

pressureEffects._comment: Chamber threat scales with current pressure; sustained overpressure literally damages the nanobot.

routePreviewTroll._comment: Day 025 — optional UI spice: at high pressure, one route card may show a fake label. Off by default. Sim always uses real exit.type.

capillary._tune: Day 173/223 — optional side bet: loot then rejoin. Not the starve bypass.
capillary.label: Capillary
capillary.blurb: Optional side bet. Loot, then rejoin.
capillary.cardCallout: SIDE BET · LOOT · REJOIN · ATTRITION RISK

rejoin._tune: Day 173 — unpaid hop off a capillary back onto the main vessel.
rejoin.label: Rejoin

shortcut._tune: Day 169 — greedy skip: ~3× vein intensity/rewards; placed by shortcuts{} not weight.
shortcut.label: Fistula Shortcut
shortcut.blurb: Skip a chamber. Triple the fight. Triple the take.

shortcuts._comment: Day 169 — optional skip edges. skipLayers=2 means depth d → d+2.

capillaries._comment: Day 173 — optional extra chambers that rejoin a main node at the same depth. chance per parent node from depth 1.

greedRamp._comment: Day 180 — greed routes scale in. The EXTRA threat/loot above the vein baseline is multiplied by floor + (1-floor)*min(1, destDepth/rampDepth): survivable-with-scars early, full spice from rampDepth on. Route cards show the effective numbers.
